articles.author: Megan Brand, Tara Prindiville, Abigail Williams, Raquel Coronell Uribe
articles.title: Trump tells U.N. he could ‘annihilate’ Iran but expects a deal after the midterm elections - NBC News
articles.description: In a speech to world leaders at the United Nations General Assembly, President Donald Trump defended the Iran conflict and said he was considering whether to “annihilate” the country and drive it “into hell.”
